inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted electric equipment, or between equipment access door and drivable surface
inputs.question: Are pad-mounted transformers or other pad-mounted electric equipment shown on the electrical design plan? If yes, are they labeled and do they have any trees shown within 10 feet of them on the landscape plan?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence check—first identifying whether pad-mounted equipment exists and is labeled on the electrical plan, then checking for tree presence within the vicinity. This is a feature-identification and presence question, not yet a distance measurement; the actual 10-foot clearance measurement would come as a follow-up.
